column8: Variant: living room with a low natural linen sofa, a wooden side table on the RIGHT with a small clay lamp, a handwoven rug. The upper-left half of the painted wall is blank.
Variant: bedroom with a wooden bed dressed in white and sand linen, a simple nightstand and lamp on the RIGHT. The upper-left half of the painted wall is blank.
Variant: dining room with a solid parota table for six, woven chairs, a natural-fiber pendant over the RIGHT side of the table. The upper-left half of the painted wall is blank.

The problem: rising damp with salt efflorescence (salitre) at the base of the wall: a white powdery crust and blistered, flaking paint up to about 60 cm above the floor, with a darker damp band above the baseboard. A wooden chair has been moved away from the wall.
Variant: two-storey house with a solid wooden front door, black steel window frames and a small tree by the entrance, set on the RIGHT half of the facade.
The six cards are warm earthy rose and terracotta tones; the natural object is a halved guava. Place the cards and objects toward the right and the center of the table.
The roller has covered about half of the wall: on the left the fresh new color, on the right the old off-white.
Variant: living room with a low linen sofa centered slightly to the RIGHT, a wooden side table, a handwoven rug. The upper-left half of the painted wall is blank.
Variant: living room with a low sofa, a ceramic table lamp on the RIGHT, a tall window on the right edge showing deep blue dusk. The upper-left half of the painted wall is blank.
